invariants.rationale: The method dereferences result and invokes multiple methods, so it must be non-null.
result.getWriteStatuses() is used for streaming and mapping, so it must not be null.
result.getPartitionToReplaceFileIds() is passed into the metadata builder, so it is expected to be non-null.
setCommitMetadata is called with an Option.of(...) value, so commit metadata is guaranteed to be present after this call.
Option.of always wraps a non-null value, so getCommitMetadata().get() should be non-null after setCommitMetadata.
